_meta.source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 — Rule 6 (mandatory declarations), Rule 7 (manner of declaration)
_meta.note: Sub-clause letters vary slightly across secondary sources; verify exact Rule 6 sub-clause lettering against the official gazette text before final submission. The substantive requirements below are accurate.
_meta.scope: Applies to packages intended for retail sale. Does NOT apply to: packages > 25kg/25L, cement/fertilizer/farm produce in bags > 50kg, or commodities sold to institutional/industrial consumers (Rule 3 exemptions) — flag these as 'exempt' rather than 'non-compliant' if detected.

declarations.label: Manufacturer / packer / importer name and address
declarations.validation: non_empty; must include a registered office address, not just a city/state
declarations.violation_message: Name and registered address of the manufacturer, packer, or importer is missing or incomplete.

declarations.label: Country of origin
declarations.condition: required only if the product is imported
declarations.violation_message: Country of origin is missing on what appears to be an imported product.

declarations.label: Common or generic name of the commodity
declarations.violation_message: Common or generic name of the commodity is not declared.

declarations.label: Net quantity (value + standard unit)
declarations.validation: must contain a numeric value AND a standard unit (g, kg, ml, l, or count for numbered items)
declarations.violation_message: Net quantity is missing, or not expressed in a standard unit of weight/volume/number.

declarations.label: Month and year of manufacture / packing / import
declarations.validation: must contain a parseable month + year, not day-only or year-only
declarations.violation_message: Month and year of manufacture, packing, or import is missing or incomplete.

declarations.label: Best before / use-by date
declarations.condition: required only for commodities that can become unfit for use/consumption over time (food, cosmetics, medicines, etc.)
declarations.violation_message: Best-before or use-by date is missing on a commodity that requires one.

declarations.label: Maximum Retail Price, inclusive of all taxes
declarations.validation: must match pattern: (MRP|Maximum Retail Price)\s*(Rs\.?|₹|INR)\s*\d+\.\d{2}.*inclusive of all taxes (case-insensitive); price to exactly 2 decimal places
declarations.violation_message: MRP is missing, not inclusive-of-taxes, or not declared to 2 decimal places in the required format.

declarations.label: Consumer care / customer support details
declarations.validation: must include at least a phone number, email, or postal address distinct from the manufacturer address
declarations.violation_message: Consumer care contact details (phone/email/address) are missing.

declarations.label: Unit sale price (for combination / group / multi-piece packages only)
declarations.condition: required only if the package contains 2+ individual pieces or units
declarations.violation_message: Unit sale price is missing on a combination or multi-piece package.

manner_of_declaration_checks.label: Readability / relative font-size risk
manner_of_declaration_checks.approach: Measure the bounding-box height of each detected declaration's text relative to the overall package/label height in the same image, rather than an absolute mm value (no calibration reference available from a standard photo). Flag as 'readability risk: low/medium/high' rather than pass/fail.
manner_of_declaration_checks.rule_citation: Rule 7(3) (minimum height) & Rule 9(1)(a) (legible and prominent), LM(PC) Rules 2011
manner_of_declaration_checks.limitation: This is a relative risk indicator, not a certified mm measurement. State this explicitly in the generated report so it isn't mistaken for a precise legal measurement.
manner_of_declaration_checks.stretch_goal: Support an optional reference-object mode (e.g. user places a standard ID card/coin in frame) for a closer-to-absolute measurement in a future version.

manner_of_declaration_checks.label: Declaration grouping / principal display panel placement
manner_of_declaration_checks.approach: Check whether required declarations are detected within a plausibly contiguous region of the image (principal display panel) rather than scattered/absent.

non_standard_or_misleading_detection.in_scope_for_mvp: Format/pattern violations only — e.g. MRP not in the required 'inclusive of all taxes' format, non-standard units, malformed dates.
non_standard_or_misleading_detection.deferred: Detecting semantically misleading claims (e.g. exaggerated marketing language) requires NLP judgment beyond rule-matching and is flagged as future work, not MVP scope.
non_standard_or_misleading_detection.reasoning: Keeps the MVP's claims verifiable and rule-traceable rather than making subjective calls a hackathon-stage model can't reliably defend.
